ledger_f007_block:
[VERIFIED] F007: In a replication conducted with 2,557 participants at 12 sites in 11 countries, participants assigned to do an everyday activity reported significantly greater enjoyment than participants assigned to think for pleasure in every country sampled. ([khu.elsevierpure.com](https://khu.elsevierpure.com/en/publications/cross-cultural-consistency-and-relativity-in-the-enjoyment-of-thi/))
  scope: 2,557 participants; 12 sites; 11 countries; participants were college students
  conditions: Participants were randomly assigned either to think for pleasure or to engage in an everyday solitary activity such as reading or watching a video.
  numeric_value: N=2,557; 12 sites; 11 countries (numeric_scope: Full cross-cultural sample)
  date_or_period: 2019
  causal_strength: CAUSAL_STATED_BY_SOURCE
  notes_for_writer: The finding supports a cross-sample tendency, not a claim that all cultures or all individuals prefer activity over thought.
old_sentence: In a study of 2,557 college students at 12 sites in 11 countries, an everyday activity was enjoyed more than thinking for pleasure in every country tested.
new_sentence_candidate_1: In a study of about 2,500 college students in 11 countries, an everyday activity was enjoyed more than thinking for pleasure in every country tested.
new_sentence_candidate_2_split: In a study of about 2,500 college students in 11 countries, an everyday activity was enjoyed more than thinking for pleasure. This was true in every country tested.
assessment: Ledger F007の実測値はN=2,557participants(college students); 12 sites; 11 countries。候補文は'about 2,500'(2,557の概数化、丸め)・'in 11 countries'(Ledgerと完全一致)を使い、'at 12 sites'を省略する。数の丸めはSpoken-first Number Treatment原則(精度自体に意味がない数字は丸め・概数化してよい)と整合し、サイト数の省略は新しい主張の追加ではなく既存情報の一部を述べないだけであり、Ledgerとの矛盾(scope expansion/causal strengthening/invented connection等)には該当しない。「an everyday activity was enjoyed more than thinking for pleasure in every country tested」の部分はLedgerの結論(every country sampledで一貫)と一致し不変。
